create.name: Ipek Williamson
create.bio:
Ipek Williamson is a meditation teacher, coach and author based in Ontario, Canada, whose work keeps returning to one theme: how we relate to ourselves. She spent around twenty years in corporate roles, and through a run of upheavals, including divorce, remarriage, becoming a stepmother and the sudden end of her office career, meditation became the steady point she relied on. She later built her teaching around it, blending mindfulness, breathwork and HeartMath techniques with ideas from Buddhist philosophy and the manifesting teachings of Neville Goddard.

On Insight Timer she has published more than two hundred tracks and several courses, among them a four-part series on who you are 'being' with yourself, with family and friends, with a partner and at work, and she leads a free live session every Friday morning as well as the Circle of Bliss community. Alongside this she works as a transformation and leadership coach, offering one-to-one coaching for executives, team sessions and workplace wellness talks, mostly online for clients in many countries. Her books include Live Your Life in a Meditative State, a short and playful introduction to everyday meditation, and a mandala colouring book for mindful relaxation.

books.title: Live Your Life in a Meditative State: Easy and Fun Ways of Meditation and Mindfulness for Everyone
books.author: Ipek Williamson
books.description: A short paperback guide that shows how meditation and mindfulness can be woven into ordinary activities, with simple, light-hearted practices for readers who are new to sitting still.

books.title: Color with Ipek: Meditative Mandalas: Coloring for Mindfulness and Relaxation
books.author: Ipek Williamson
books.description: An adult colouring book of mandala designs meant to be used as a slow, focused practice, a way of resting attention on one simple task.

courses.title: The Neville Goddard Method: How To Create Your Reality From The Inside Out
courses.description: A seven-day video course on Insight Timer that turns Neville Goddard's teaching, that inner assumptions shape outer life, into short daily practices: working with 'I am' statements, living from the end result, revising past scenes and persisting until change shows up.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Who You Are Being With Yourself
courses.description: The first of Ipek's four-part Insight Timer series on 'being'. Over seven short days it looks at self-awareness, self-care, self-love, acceptance and forgiveness, and ends with writing your own 'I am' declarations.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: One-on-One Executive & Leader Coaching
courses.description: Personal coaching for executives and team leaders going through change, focused on clarity, emotional intelligence, steadiness under pressure and decision-making. Team coaching and workshops are offered from the same page, and a free exploratory call comes first.

courses.title: Create Your Mind Movie
courses.description: A recorded workshop with a ready-made Canva template for making a 'mind movie', a short personal video of images, affirmations and music to watch daily as a moving vision board for what you want to create.

free_resources.title: Ipek Williamson on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: More than two hundred of Ipek's guided meditations, affirmations and short courses on self-worth, relationships and manifesting, free to hear in the app or on the web, plus her free live session on Friday mornings.

flags: Mainly a transformation and leadership coach whose website is about executive and team coaching; the spiritual side (meditation, Neville Goddard manifesting, Circle of Bliss) lives mostly on Insight Timer. Owner may judge whether she fits as a teacher.
Email ipek@ipekwilliamsoncoaching.com is the mailto behind the 'Email' button on her Linktree (a link page she runs); it is not printed as text on her website, which uses a contact form.

Health rule, minor: her free meditation bundle (site and Linktree) leads with 'Sleep Meditation to Let Insomnia Go', and her Meditation Masterclass course on Insight Timer makes anxiety and sleep claims; both left out. Her coaching pages are framed around life transitions, not conditions.
Her YouTube channel is mostly Shorts, testimonials and event clips; only three full-length teaching videos qualified.
Photos: the YouTube avatar (grey hair, outdoors) and the website headshot (short dark hair, office) look like the same woman a few years apart; both on her own accounts.
Linktree carries affiliate links (Talkspace, Headspace and others); nothing from them is in the plan.
left_out: Meditation Masterclass For Beginners (Insight Timer course): lessons claim support for anxiety and better sleep.
Free download of three meditations: includes 'Sleep Meditation to Let Insomnia Go' (condition in title).
Little Fawna Is Loved, Safe, and Never Alone (children's book, ISBN 1778065503): Amazon /dp/ page returned 500, not verified.
Threads of Light e-book ($33 on Payhip): Payhip blocked the request, page not verified.
Other Insight Timer 'Who You Are Being' courses: limit of two Insight Timer courses.
YouTube Shorts, testimonials, event clips and a 'Mental & Physical Health' clip.
Hosted team events on Elevent and corporate wellness sessions: workplace bookings with no page of their own.
